segmentation_lexicon.description: script/prepare_lexicon.py output (.cache/mcbopomofo/lexicon.tsv) followed by Resources/local_phrases.tsv, as script/build_site_assets.sh concatenates them

build: python tools/homophone_bigram.py build <the four shards> --resources <dir with lexicon.tsv> --out pairs.tsv --keep 3 --ambiguity toneless
python tools/homophone_bigram.py export --pairs pairs.tsv --out homophone.bin --top-pairs 300000 --rank sqrt --min-count 3 --cap 4 --smooth 3 --ambiguity toneless --resources <dir with lexicon.tsv>
notes: --ambiguity toneless counts pairs whose second word shares its reading with tones dropped (a superset of the 2026-10-12 build). Exporting the same pairs.tsv with --ambiguity reading --top-pairs 200000 reproduces the previous homophone.bin bit for bit (sha256 fda8d3167e5ca7c4e4c18a5f9a30ee1d7f7aa7144a16126d4ecaf8b11c840207); the 300,000-pair table contains all of its pairs plus 100,000 cross-tone ones.

word_model.description: Resources/word_model.bin: MSLM v3 word-pair model (5,000,000 gain-ranked pairs) counted over all documents of the four pinned shards
word_model.segmentation: the pinned segmentation lexicon plus .cache/gov/places.tsv (third_party/TaiwanOpenData/sources.json, sha256 5e1d87cc...)
word_model.excluded: Han runs equal to an evaluation sentence (tools/first_choice_eval.py cv-legacy, tools/eval/typing_corpus.tsv, .cache/eval-reserve/external-v1.tsv; 2,662 sentences, 19,764 runs) are not counted
build: python tools/word_lm.py --documents 0 --extra-lexicon .cache/gov/places.tsv --exclude <evaluation sentences, one per line> --out all-clean.bin
python tools/prune_word_lm.py --source all-clean.bin --rank gain --budgets 5000000 --format v2  (writes v3 packing for vocabularies over 2**17)
